status: Engineering proposals; continuous alarm use is known, speaker and loudness target are not selected

amplifier.notes: Datasheet test loads include 68 uH with 8 ohm and 33 uH with 4 ohm. Values do not guarantee speaker distortion or clipping margin at every voltage/temperature.

battery_sweep.notes: 0.25 A is a reference average, 0.5 A a sustained digital stress assumption; neither is a measured firmware load. 2.5 W is the 4-ohm comparison and is not a proposal to drive the 8-ohm candidate at that power.

thermal.notes: Three-AA nominal/lower-IR alkaline sensitivity: 3*0.15 ohm plus 0.10 ohm holder/wires, plus separate inherited Q1 resistance. 80 percent incremental audio efficiency is an assumed loss sensitivity, not a guaranteed minimum. h and internal air temperature remain unconfirmed.
